dedupe_keys.name: energy production by solar facade of the taltech residential dc innovation hub

description: Andrii Chub deposited daily solar-façade energy-production records from the TalTech Residential DC Innovation Hub in Tallinn, Estonia. The series initially covers 1 January 2024 to 30 September 2026. Energy is expressed in kWh and the description identifies 33 monthly CSV files, each containing daily records. The façade faces approximately 12 degrees east of due south, with an azimuth of 168 degrees. The file listing also includes monthly totals, explanatory metadata and illustrations. These measurements provide a building-scale generation series for solar-energy studies and electricity capacity planning. The repository offers public access under CC BY 4.0 at no stated charge. The producer intends to extend the series, but does not state a fixed update interval. Missing-value treatment and measurement uncertainty are not established in the repository description. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
